itemListElement.name: AI readiness assessment for mid-market and enterprise organisations

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI readiness assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a mid-sized organisation it typically takes two to four weeks. Smaller scopes can be done in two weeks, and organisations with several business units or regulated environments take longer.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us?

acceptedAnswer.text: An executive sponsor, six to ten stakeholder interviews, access to key documents, systems and data catalogues, and two working sessions with your leadership team.

mainEntity.name: Do you recommend specific vendors or platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text: The assessment is vendor-neutral. It identifies what capability you need and whether to build, buy or partner. If implementation follows, any work through Inova AI Solutions is proposed separately and disclosed upfront.
You choose: run the roadmap with your own team, add a governance build, bring in delivery support, or keep me on as a fractional Chief AI Officer to own the roadmap with you.
